title.zh: 接合检验随同一编码保真
title.en: Joining questions remain exact under the same encoding

claim.zh: 将问题中每个接合伙伴按同一说明编码后，在诱导多结果接合关系内解释所得问题，答案与原问题相同。
claim.en: After encoding every joining partner in a question through the same account, interpreting the translated question in the induced multivalued joining relation gives exactly the original answer.

hypotheses.zh: 同一部分接合 J；每对输入具有有限结果集合。
hypotheses.en: One partial joining relation J; each input pair has a finite outcome set.

hypotheses.zh: 目标含全部有限否定、合取、左右接合后继问题，无独立原子谓词。
hypotheses.en: The target contains all finite negation, conjunction and left/right joining-successor questions, with no independent atomic predicates.

hypotheses.zh: Exact 给出完整精确答案；Reduced 仅用于最小代码与输出代码的提升。
hypotheses.en: Exact supplies complete truthful answers; Reduced is used for minimal codes and lifting output codes.

correspondence.zh: 片段、接合及其检验解释同一活动内的关系；数学语义不等于所有问题已被实际取得。
correspondence.en: Fragments, joining and its questions interpret relations within the same activity; mathematical semantics does not establish acquired access to every answer.

detail.zh: 代表片段一致的输出提升接入复合结构。
detail.en: Representative-wise output lifting feeds the compound structure.

output.zh: 每个编码输出可由指定输入对实现。
output.en: Every code outcome is realizable by the specified input pair.

input.zh: questions_survive_encoding 在每个左右接续问题消费 operation_lifts，并递归保持逻辑联结。
input.en: questions_survive_encoding consumes operation_lifts at every left/right successor question and recursively preserves the logical constructors.

conditions.zh: 同一 J、编码、有限纤维、Exact、Reduced 完整保留。
conditions.en: The same J, encoding, finite fibers, Exact and Reduced are retained.

detail.zh: 涵盖有限否定、合取及接续的语义，不证明检验装置形成、实际负面证据或所有问题已取得。
detail.en: Covers semantics of finite negation, conjunction and continuation; it does not establish apparatus formation, actual negative evidence or acquired access to all questions.

limitations.zh: 涵盖有限否定、合取及接续的语义，不证明检验装置形成、实际负面证据或所有问题已取得。
limitations.en: Covers semantics of finite negation, conjunction and continuation; it does not establish apparatus formation, actual negative evidence or acquired access to all questions.

validation_scope.zh: 所列 Lean 源码与成功冻结回执逐字哈希绑定；本轮223项审计含26项新声明。旧功能性定理信用此前166项回执，未冒充新证明。
validation_scope.en: Listed Lean sources bind by exact hash to successful frozen receipts. This round checks 223 declarations including 26 new ones. The older functional theorem credits its previous 166-audit receipt, not a new proof.

next_delta.zh: 从同一形成的不同关系分节取得共同细化或互译，不预设同一片段集与伙伴对齐；不重开已完成的有限结果恢复。
next_delta.en: Earn common refinement or translation between different articulations of the same formation without presupposing a common fragment set and partner alignment; reuse completed finite-outcome recovery.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：在既有接合情境研究中接续；已完成结果分别迁移，新连接与复用分列。
history.en: 2026-10-08: continued the existing joining-context study; migrated completed claims separately and distinguished new connections from reuse.
